review_candidates.title: Principal Software Engineer (Networking) - Platform Infra
review_candidates.description: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. What is The Role: We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join Platform Infrastructure - Application Networking and set where Elastic Cloud application networking goes next. This work covers Ingress, security controls, private connectivity, and DNS management — the path every interaction with Elasticsearch, Kibana, and the broader Elastic stack takes. You will drive the technical vision, architecture, and design of these systems, not just execute against an existing roadmap. This is a Principal-level role for an engineer who has designed high-performance, scalable networking platforms and can drive technical initiatives across organizations. Elastic is investing in the reliability, security, and reach of Elastic Cloud; you will hold a high bar for those qualities while other engineering teams rely on what this platform provides. What You Will Be Doing: Set the technical direction for major application networking initiatives, owning designs from proposal through general availability. Lead the development of Ingress, private connectivity, DNS, and security controls on a large scale for Elastic Cloud. Continuously identify and address issues related to performance, reliability, and operability. Lead multi-quarter, cross-organizational projects that other Elastic engineering teams rely on, and guide these projects through to delivery. Raise the operational quality of our services. Take charge of operational investigations from beginning to end. Lead complex incident investigations and reviews. Participate in on-call rotation. Mentor and support engineers across the team, serve as a subject matter expert and trusted technical advisor to the wider engineering organization, and set the standard for how we build software. Partner with and advise product management and senior engineering stakeholders on technical trade-offs, feasibility, and roadmap direction. Identify and champion improvements to security, stability, and cost efficiency before they become problems. Untangle complexity and bring architectural clarity across the platform. What You Bring: Experience with building software, including setting technical direction for complex distributed systems running production at scale (Staff or Principal level, or equivalent scope). Deep expertise in application networking and cloud-native architecture. You should understand how services communicate at scale. Knowledge of how to design, operate, and evolve Ingress, private connectivity, DNS, and security controls is required. You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services. You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components. You have experience guiding work involving multiple engineers. You have operated high-availability SaaS platforms, responded to incidents, and improved reliability over time. You care about the quality of work shipped — testing, observability, and operability. You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes. You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities. You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication. You communicate clearly and can influence direction across teams and levels without formal authority. Bonus Points: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes networking (Cilium, external-dns, Envoy Gateway, and Crossplane) and with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its networking ecosystem. You have contributed to CNCF or other open-source networking projects Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People: As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do. We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do. Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary Health coverage for you and your family in many locations Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles Generous number of vacation days each year Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave Security & Privacy Responsibilities: Take ownership of protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of organizational data and systems by following applicable privacy and security policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). Proactively participate in mandatory role-based training to ensure personal technical execution consistently aligns with the highest standards of data protection, data privacy, and system resilience. Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation. We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email candidate_accessibility@elastic.co. We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission. Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws and can view the following posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster Elasticsearch develops and distributes technology and information that is subject to U.S. and other countries’ export controls and licensing requirements for individuals who are located in or are nationals of the following sanctioned countries and regions: Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, or Russia, including the Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia (The Crimea region of Ukraine, The Donetsk People's Republic (DNR), The Luhansk People's Republic (LNR), Kherson or Zaporizhzhia). If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic. Please see here for our Privacy Statement. Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets. The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position. The typical starting salary range for this role is: €84.300—€109.500 EUR

The company serves key government and commercial clients in 10 languages across sites in Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia. Xceed delivers a wide range of services, including inbound and outbound customer support, back office operations, infrastructure management, recruitment process outsourcing, helpdesk support, and social media analysis. The organization has received numerous regional and international awards for outsourcing excellence, customer experience, impact sourcing, CSR, sustainability, diversity, equity, and inclusion. Xceed holds multiple global certifications such as COPC and several ISO standards, underscoring its commitment to quality, security, and business continuity. Role Description The Senior Supervisor Application Developer – (AI & .NET) is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for leading the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise applications that support Xceed’s BPO operations. This role oversees a team of developers, providing technical guidance on AI-driven solutions and .NET-based applications, and ensuring adherence to best practices and coding standards. Daily responsibilities include architecting and implementing new software features, integrating applications with internal and external systems, optimizing performance, and maintaining secure, reliable databases. The Senior Supervisor collaborates with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, translate business needs into technical specifications, and deliver scalable solutions on time. The role also involves code reviews, documentation, mentoring team members, and supporting production environments through troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Software Development and Programming skills, with advanced experience in .NET technologies and AI/ML frameworks. Candidates should possess solid Databases skills, including design, optimization, and management of relational and/or NoSQL databases. Candidates should possess Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and related front-end technologies skills to support user interface development and refinement. Candidates should possess Integration skills, including working with APIs, microservices, and system-to-system data flows. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field; advanced certifications in .NET, cloud platforms, or AI are an advantage. Proven experience in leading development teams, managing projects, and delivering enterprise applications in a production environment. Strong problem-solving abilities, secure coding practices, familiarity with SDLC, DevOps tools, and version control systems (e.g., Git). Effective communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced on-site environment.

review_candidates.title: Machine Learning Engineer
review_candidates.description: About us: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 200 customers worldwide . But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people . With a team of over 1500 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe, Asia, and the US, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. Zagreb office is part of OddsMatrix, which empowers clients to unleash bold ideas and deliver outstanding player experiences. For over a decade, we have offered tailored B2B sports betting solutions for every market. Featured services include turnkey betting software (online, retail and omnichannel), real-time sports data APIs and data feeds. We are looking for a passionate and dedicated Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Zagreb, Croatia! What you'll get to do: Analyze business requests and design, develop and optimize data-driven machine learning models. Collect, clean and prepare data for model training and evaluation. Evaluate and compare various mathematical and statistical modeling techniques, measuring performance and identifying improvement opportunities. Implement approved ML models in collaboration with developers and ensure smooth integration into production environments. Support product teams with mathematical expertise (e.g., creating formulas for new betting features or optimizing existing algorithms). Provide guidance to internal stakeholders on model usage, interpretation and potential limitations. Monitor model performance and continuously improve accuracy, scalability and reliability. Act as a strong analytical partner within a cross-functional team, contributing to product innovation and decision-making. What you need to shine: Strong background in mathematics, statistics or machine learning. Experience building, evaluating and deploying ML models in production environments, specifically deep learning architectures. Knowledge of and good awareness on when to use different Neural Network architectures, up to and including the current state of the art. Proficiency in Python (or similar language) and experience with ML libraries/frameworks. Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering and model evaluation techniques. Understanding of performance metrics and model validation strategies. Ability to translate business problems into mathematical and technical solutions. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Nice to have: Experience in betting, gaming, fintech or similar data-intensive industries. Experience with cloud environments and ML deployment pipelines. Knowledge of real-time data processing systems. Experience with generative AI projects – architecture, planning, training, tracking/assessment and iteration. Experience with working across all steps of a complete data science framework (for ex. CRISP). MLOps experience on the cloud or on-premises. Here's what we offer: A salary from 4.000 EUR - 6.000 EUR (gross/brutto1). Sliding work schedule (start anytime between 8:00 to 10:00 am). Start with 23 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 33 days by your fifth year with us. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. Support for New Parents: 21 weeks of paid maternity leave, with the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child turns 1 year old. 4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old. Our office perks include on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. Benefits & Perks: Monthly meal allowance. Paid Personal Days for specific life events, including but not limited to childbirth, wedding, relocation, blood donation, and volunteering. Private health insurance and an extended health plan – Wiener; annual medical checks at the Aviva polyclinic. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business or O’Reilly and a budget for external training. Multisport card. Travel expenses – depending on the place of residence. Easter, Christmas, summer and referral bonuses. At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

review_candidates.description: We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Backend to join Procore’s Collaboration Division . In this role, you’ll focus on creating the common cores of our future application platform. Your primary goal is to empower internal and external teams to efficiently and collaboratively create and deliver experiences on the Procore Platform. As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend , you’ll partner with Engineering, Product, and UX teams to develop roadmaps, tackle initiatives, and solve critical business problems. Use your expertise in Service-Oriented Architecture, modern web development, and API design to directly enable all experiences built on the platform to seamlessly interact and fulfill our customers' unique construction needs on a global scale. Help drive the immediate and long-term strategic direction for major parts of our technology stack, Apply today to join our team. This position reports into the Senior Manager, Software Engineering and will be based in our Cairo, Egypt office . We’re looking for someone to join us immediately. What you’ll do: AI is central to how we work. You’ll be expected to master generative tools and agentic workflows, moving beyond just using AI to actively building the agentic future of construction. Design and develop core platform services leveraging Procore's platform technologies via several delivery channels to align with our technical vision of a service-oriented architecture. Build underlying application platform features that enable customization and platform extensibility by users, first- or third-party developers, and our application teams. Drive key teams that are building our next wave of technology design for the future of Procore, serving as a subject matter expert in your domain. Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and UX to design and build solutions that delight users and solve critical business problems. Troubleshoot and debug complex technical issues, providing innovative solutions to challenges that arise during development. Build a culture of mentorship, innovation, and recognition by leading our strategic objectives at the team level and developing teammates through code reviews, pairing, and training opportunities. What we’re looking for: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, a related field, or possess comparable work experience. You have 5+ years of experience in Object-Oriented Program fundamentals, Test Driven Development, and Design principles (Java, Kafka, Ruby on Rails, Typescript). You possess strong experience designing and building highly scalable, performant software in a Service-Oriented Architecture, including proficiency in implementing APIs and asynchronous streaming platforms. You bring time-honed expertise working with our stack of Java, Kafka, Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL, and Node.js across the entire spectrum of modern web development, testing, staging, deploying, and monitoring. You are familiar with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Sumo Logic) and telemetry standards such as OpenTelemetry (OTel). You demonstrate a track record of anticipating technical problems that fall out of major projects, designing solutions to overcome those problems, and bringing team clarity to complex solutions. You have a curious mind and are driven to innovate and solve customer problems.
